sources.snippet: About Qwen3-1.7B Qwen3-1.7B is a dense causal language model engineered by the Alibaba Qwen team as a high-efficiency solution for general-purpose language processing and reasoning. Introduced as part of the Qwen3 series on April 29, 2025, the model is designed to operate effectively across diverse hardware environments, including mobile devices and edge computing platforms.
